segments.he: מַתְנִי' הַמַּכֶּה אָבִיו וְאִמּוֹ אֵינוֹ חַיָּיב עַד שֶׁיַּעֲשֶׂה בָּהֶן חַבּוּרָה זֶה חוֹמֶר בַּמְקַלֵּל מִבַּמַּכֶּה שֶׁהַמְקַלֵּל לְאַחַר מִיתָה חַיָּיב וְהַמַּכֶּה לְאַחַר מִיתָה פָּטוּר
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «One who strikes his father or his mother is not liable» to be executed «unless he wounds» one of «them. This is a stringency with regard to one who curses» his father that is more severe «than» the halakha «with regard to one who strikes» his father, «as one who curses» his father or his mother «after» his or her «death is liable, but one who strikes» one of them «after» his or her «death is exempt,» as he did not cause a wound.

moves.summary: Wound required; cursing after death liable, striking after death exempt

positions.claim: one who strikes a parent is liable only for a wound; one who curses is liable even after death
